text:
michaela-support: FYI — Acme Analytics says their AWS Marketplace invoice and our console don't match. AWS invoice shows 1,208,456 tokens billed for Jan but Redwood Console shows 912,340 tokens. Customer attached invoice INV-AWS-12345678 and wants an explanation; their finance team thinks it's ~32% overbill.

emily-accounts: Emily (Acme): Confirmed on our side — our internal logs count ~884k tokens (we double-checked). Screenshot and the PDF are attached here: https://s3.acme.example/invoice_INV-AWS-12345678.png — can you reconcile ASAP?

james-billing: Looking. Quick Q: does AWS marketplace always bill raw metering reports or do we ever pass through post-cache numbers? Might be a mapping/aggregation issue.

ron-deploy-bot: invoice-ingest: marketplace invoice INV-AWS-12345678 processed 2025-02-02T08:12:03Z — total_billed_units: 1,208,456 (metering_report_id=MR-7890)

li-eng: I'll repro this afternoon. Can you export and attach the raw usage CSV from the console? Also attach the marketplace invoice PDF. My repro command: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/usage/exports?start=2025-01-01&end=2025-01-31&granularity=hour&format=csv" -o acme-usage-jan2025.csv
```

michaela-support: Uploaded both per request: https://s3.redwood.internal/attachments/INV-AWS-12345678.pdf and https://s3.redwood.internal/attachments/usage-acme-2025-01.csv

james-billing: Two hypotheses: 1) AWS billed raw tokens and our console shows tokens_after_cache (so numbers differ by cache hits), or 2) a marketplace price-dimension mapping bug duplicated units during ingestion. Any signs of a double-counting bug in ingestion?

sara-infra: Pasting (redacted) raw metering payload we received from AWS for MR-7890: ```{ "marketplace_id": "MR-7890", "account_id": "123456789012", "resources": [{"dimension": "tokens", "count": 1208456}], "received_at": "2025-02-02T08:11:58Z" }```

li-eng: That matches the AWS-side count. I diffed the CSV export vs. the raw payload: our console shows `tokens_post_cache=912340`, AWS raw `tokens_raw=1208456`. I can see where the mismatch comes from: our exporter reports the post-cache metric (we subtract KV/prefix cache served tokens), but marketplace metering reports raw consumed tokens.

james-billing: That explains the delta. Marketplace invoices will reflect the raw metering reports at time of meter submission. We need to make this transparent for Marketplace customers. Action items: 1) Billing drafts explanation and propose credit policy for cases where cache-deduction caused customer confusion, 2) Eng to expose `raw_tokens` in the Console and in exports for Marketplace accounts, 3) File a confirmation with AWS Marketplace on MR-7890 to ensure no ingestion duplication. I've opened internal ticket RDW-2025-339 and AWS case 5463721.

michaela-support: I'll reply to the customer with a short explanation and tell them we're investigating and proposing a provisional credit while we reconcile. Suggested wording welcome. :eyes:

li-eng: Suggested blurb to send now: "AWS Marketplace invoices reflect raw metering reports submitted to AWS. Redwood Console displays tokens after prefix/KV cache deductions and per-request rounding which can be lower than raw tokens. For Marketplace-billed accounts we will surface both raw_tokens and post_cache_tokens in exports and the Console; in the meantime we're reviewing your invoice and will propose a credit if appropriate (RDW-2025-339)."

emily-accounts: Thanks — that helps. Our audit team needs confirmation by EOD Friday; please escalate if you need more time. :pray:

michaela-support: Marking high priority and will escalate. I'll send the suggested blurb and note the internal ticket IDs. Will update this thread after James/billing confirms credit path (RDW-2025-339) and after we hear back from AWS case 5463721.

james-billing: Also note: if a customer enabled any Marketplace-level discounts/promotions, AWS may apply adjustments after initial metering which could change final invoice. We'll watch for any post-invoice adjustments but initial bill reflects MR-7890 numbers.

sara-infra: Filed a follow-up to add a `raw_tokens` column in the next export job; ETA 2 sprints unless urgent.

michaela-support: Thanks everyone — I'll reply to the customer now and loop in Finance for credit decision.

emily-accounts: Appreciate the quick response. Please cc our billing contact (billing@acme.example).

michaela-support: Done. Closing customer-facing update for now; will leave this internal thread open until RDW-2025-339 is resolved.
